contexts.text: No life of anyone can exist that is dissociated from that of others.
Under Consociate, see this reference, and at AC 1398:end.
As each wants to be served and worshipped by others, and loves no one but himself, there results dissociation, which is determined... into lamentable states...
These loves... were taken away from him, which is effected in the other life by dissociation.
Therefore, they who have disagreed in animus are separated.
